description: This file implements the Wayland subcompositor interface, including functions for managing subsurfaces and the subcompositor, such as creation, destruction, and positioning of subsurfaces within the Wayland display server.

methods.name: subsurface_set_position
methods.description: Sets the position of a subsurface.

methods.name: subsurface_place_above
methods.description: Places a subsurface above another surface.

methods.name: subsurface_place_below
methods.description: Places a subsurface below another surface.

methods.name: subsurface_set_sync
methods.description: Sets the subsurface to sync mode.

methods.name: subsurface_set_desync
methods.description: Sets the subsurface to desync mode.

methods.name: subcompositor_get_subsurface
methods.description: Creates a subsurface resource for a surface.

methods.name: subcompositor_destroy_resource_callback
methods.description: Callback for when a subcompositor resource is destroyed.

methods.name: bind_subcompositor
methods.description: Binds the subcompositor interface to the Wayland display.

methods.name: BindSubcompositorInterface
methods.description: Exports the function to bind the subcompositor interface to a Wayland display.
